title: Plumeform button (v2)
description: Pill buttons and an underlined link. Solid is foreground-coloured (ink on paper, paper on the dark bands) and turns plume teal (mint on dark) on hover with a 1px lift; soft is a quiet bordered pill; link is bold text with a 2px teal underline and a separately underlined arrow.
notes: solid follows the foreground colour, so it flips between ink and paper with the dark class
